plugins.name: kubo-ipfs-agentic
plugins.description: Build an IPFS MCP server for agents, agentskills.io-compliant skills packaged as plugins for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and Kimi Code marketplaces, and an MCP App with a shared A2UI-compatible React 19 component library for IPFS-specific agentic UI, without breaking Kubo RPC, gateway, CID or wire compatibility guarantees.
